	External calls:
	- res = msg.sender.call.value(amount)() (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_045.sol#19)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- credit[msg.sender] -= amount (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_045.sol#20)
	SimpleDAO.credit (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_045.sol#10) can be used in cross function reentrancies:
	- SimpleDAO.donate(address) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_045.sol#12-14)
	- SimpleDAO.queryCredit(address) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_045.sol#24-26)
	- SimpleDAO.withdraw(uint256) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_045.sol#16-22)
